hormuz_severe_flow_mult.source_ref: stated assumption, sensitivity-swept 0.1-0.4; severe-attack anchor Abqaiq 2019 (5.7 mb/d instant loss, EIA #41413). Not fit to Hormuz-2026 outcomes.
